name: vidpal
description: Create, edit, clip and publish videos from a chat.

interface.longDescription:
Vidpal makes and edits videos for the signed-in Vidpal account.

- Generate a narrated video from a topic, your own script, or a public article URL. Vidpal writes the script and adds a voiceover, captions, and visuals from stock clips or AI-generated images, in portrait (Shorts, Reels, TikTok) or landscape.
- Clean up your own recording: remove silences and filler words, add captions, automatic zooms and b-roll.
- Cut a long recording such as a podcast, interview or webinar into short captioned clips.
- Publish or schedule finished videos to your connected Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and LinkedIn accounts.

Requires a Vidpal account. What is available depends on the account's Vidpal plan. Video files are uploaded through a one-time link, not through the chat.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second vertical video about three budgeting tips for students
Cut my podcast recording into Shorts with captions
Turn this blog post into a narrated video

positive.description: Generate a narrated video from a topic, review the script, confirm it, export and get the MP4.
positive.prompt: Make a 30-second vertical video about three budgeting tips for students
positive.tools_triggered: create_video_from_prompt, get_script, confirm_script, get_video, export_video, get_video
positive.expected_behavior: Vidpal writes a script and ChatGPT shows it; after confirmation the voiceover and visuals are generated, the export starts, and ChatGPT returns a link to the finished MP4 (videoUrl) and the appUrl of the video in Vidpal.

positive.description: List and inspect the account's videos.
positive.prompt: Show me my latest Vidpal videos
positive.expected_behavior: The account's videos, newest first, each with its phase/status and an appUrl; details for one video on request.

positive.description: Clean up an uploaded recording and export it.
positive.prompt: Remove the silences and filler words from my latest upload and set the captions to Mozi
positive.tools_triggered: list_videos, remove_silences, remove_filler_words, set_caption_style, export_video, get_video
positive.expected_behavior: The edits are applied to the AI Editing project (the recording itself is unchanged), an export starts, and ChatGPT returns the MP4 link once rendered.

positive.description: Cut a long recording into short clips via the upload link flow.
positive.prompt: Cut my long recording into Shorts
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT gives the user a one-time upload link, waits until the upload is reported, starts clip extraction, and lists the extracted clips with titles and scores.

positive.description: Schedule a finished video to a connected platform, with confirmation.
positive.prompt: Schedule my latest exported video to YouTube for tomorrow at 9 am
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks the user to confirm (schedule_video is destructive and open-world), then reports the scheduled job and its state.

negative.description: Summarizing someone else's online video is not something Vidpal does.
negative.prompt: Summarize this YouTube video for me: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ

negative.description: Vidpal does not generate cinematic AI footage (it uses stock clips or still AI images).
negative.prompt: Generate a 5-second cinematic clip of a dragon flying over snowy mountains.

negative.description: Downloading a video from another platform is not something Vidpal does.
negative.prompt: Download this TikTok video so I can save it to my phone: https://www.tiktok.com/@example/video/123

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold in ChatGPT. The plugin uses what the signed-in account's existing Vidpal plan includes; plan and credit errors state the requirement and link to the informational pricing page only.

publication.release_notes:
1.0.2: resubmission after review feedback.

CSP / templates: Vidpal has no UI component. No tool links a UI template: there is no _meta.ui.resourceUri or openai/outputTemplate on any tool, the server registers no resources (no resources capability, no ui:// or text/html templates), and no tool result embeds HTML or an iframe. Every tool returns plain-text JSON content plus structuredContent only, so there is no widget whose CSP could be declared. The only ChatGPT-specific _meta keys in 1.0.1 were openai/toolInvocation/invoking and /invoked (status text) on six tools; 1.0.2 removes them, so every tool's _meta is now exactly the securitySchemes auth policy. Links in results (appUrl, videoUrl) are plain URLs the user opens in a browser tab, never embedded.

Tool annotations are unchanged from 1.0.1:

Per-tool justification:
- list_videos (readOnly true, destructive false, idempotent true, openWorld false): Lists the account's own videos. Writes nothing.
- get_video (readOnly true, destructive false, idempotent true, openWorld false): Returns one of the account's videos. Writes nothing.
- get_script (readOnly true, destructive false, idempotent true, openWorld false): Returns the stored script of one of the account's videos. Writes nothing.
- confirm_script (readOnly false, destructive true, idempotent true, openWorld false): The lock and the generated media cannot be undone from here: changing the script afterwards means unlocking and regenerating in Vidpal. No credits are charged by this call (the video was charged when it was created).
- list_voices (readOnly true, destructive false, idempotent true, openWorld false): Lists the narration voice catalog. Writes nothing.
- list_caption_presets (readOnly true, destructive false, idempotent true, openWorld false): Lists the fixed caption preset names. Writes nothing.
- create_upload_link (readOnly false, destructive false, idempotent false, openWorld false): Additive only: nothing is overwritten or removed, and an unused link simply expires after 30 minutes.
- get_upload_status (readOnly true, destructive false, idempotent true, openWorld false): Reports the state of one of the account's upload links. Writes nothing.
- create_video_from_prompt (readOnly false, destructive true, idempotent false, openWorld false): Charges the account's credits (1 portrait / 5 landscape); the charge is not reversible.
- create_video_from_url (readOnly false, destructive true, idempotent false, openWorld true): Charges the account's credits (1 portrait / 5 landscape); the charge is not reversible. Fetches whatever public web page the caller passes: open-ended access to the public internet.
- create_editing_project (readOnly false, destructive true, idempotent true, openWorld false): Charges 1 credit; the charge is not reversible.
- ai_edit (readOnly false, destructive true, idempotent false, openWorld false): Replaces the project's existing overlay plan; the previous plan is not kept. No credits are charged by this call — the next export_video renders the plan and is charged as an export.
- remove_silences (readOnly false, destructive false, idempotent true, openWorld false): A non-destructive edit: the uploaded recording is unchanged and the cuts are timeline markers the user can clear in the Vidpal editor before exporting.
- remove_filler_words (readOnly false, destructive false, idempotent true, openWorld false): A non-destructive edit: the uploaded recording is unchanged and the cuts can be cleared in the Vidpal editor before exporting.
- auto_zooms (readOnly false, destructive true, idempotent false, openWorld false): Replaces the project's existing zoom moments, including any placed by hand; the previous set is not kept.
- auto_broll (readOnly false, destructive true, idempotent false, openWorld false): Replaces the project's existing b-roll moments, including any placed by hand; the previous set is not kept.
- set_caption_style (readOnly false, destructive false, idempotent true, openWorld false): Only the fields passed change, and every field can be set back; nothing is lost.
- export_video (readOnly false, destructive true, idempotent true, openWorld false): Charges credits (1 portrait / 5 landscape) when the content changed since the last export; the charge is not reversible.
- create_clips (readOnly false, destructive true, idempotent true, openWorld false): Charges 1 credit per 10 minutes of source; the charge is not reversible.
- list_clips (readOnly true, destructive false, idempotent true, openWorld false): Lists the clips extracted from one of the account's videos. Writes nothing.
- list_publish_connections (readOnly true, destructive false, idempotent true, openWorld false): Lists the account's connected social accounts. Writes nothing.
- publish_video (readOnly false, destructive true, idempotent true, openWorld true): Posts publicly on the user's own social accounts; a live post cannot be recalled from here. The post is visible to the public on Instagram, YouTube, TikTok or LinkedIn.
- schedule_video (readOnly false, destructive true, idempotent true, openWorld true): Schedules a public post that goes live at the given time unless cancel_publish is called first, and locks the video from re-export meanwhile. Once posted, the content is visible to the public on Instagram, YouTube, TikTok or LinkedIn.
- get_publish_status (readOnly true, destructive false, idempotent true, openWorld false): Returns the video's publishing jobs. It refreshes the cached job states from the publishing provider (rate-limited) but changes nothing about what is posted or scheduled.
- cancel_publish (readOnly false, destructive true, idempotent true, openWorld false): Removes the scheduled posts; getting them back means scheduling again. Jobs already processing or live are left alone.
